statement: Conditional hand derivation: for p>3,d=2^t>=8,p>=256d^4, the cited fine-moduli count Y1(d)(Fp)>=p/2 yields at least p(p-1)/2 pointed short models. Uniform(a,x0) plus complete uniform rational halving therefore succeeds with probability at least1/d^2 per unbounded subgroup trial, giving expected O(d^2*t*poly(log p)) work without a point count. This is conditional mathematical accounting, not a formal program proof, finite-cap guarantee, validated native growing-family cost, or complete ECDLP complexity claim.
